building_details.building_ref: Side extension to the existing Club House

site_name: Bush Hill Park Bowls Tennis And Social Club
subdivision_of_building: The proposed extension is located to the side of the existing snooker room in the rear car park off of Longleat Road
description: Single storey rear extension to existing snooker room to create space for one additional snooker table.
decision_conditions: The proposed rear extension, by reason of its scale, form, siting, detailed design and cumulative impact, would result in a piecemeal and visually disjointed addition to an already extended building, giving rise to a cluttered and incoherent form that would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding Bush Hill Park Conservation Area. The identified harm to the designated heritage asset is considered to constitute less than substantial harm and is not outweighed by any public benefits. The proposal is therefore contrary to Sections 12 and 16 of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024; Policy HC1 of the London Plan 2021; Policy DMD 44 of the Development Management Document; Core Strategy Policy 31; and the Bush Hill Park Conservation Area Character Appraisal and Management Proposals (2015).

In the absence of a site-specific Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) to demonstrate the development would be safe for its lifetime and would not increase flood risk elsewhere, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied the proposal is acceptable. The proposal is therefore contrary to guidance in Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024); Policies SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021); Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD59, DMD60 and DMD61 of the Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, in the absence of an adequate arboriculture report, has failed to demonstrate that the proposal would retain and protect a street tree of visual amenity and biodiversity value in the adjacent highway, contrary to Section 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies G6 and G7 of the London Plan (2021), CP34 and CP36 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD37, DMD79, DMD 80 and DMD81 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and the British Standard for Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction (BS 5837:2012).
